kind: Design skill, local Python retrieval dataset and optional installer
findings: Routes a short dominant-intent query to design-system, domain or actual stack retrieval; explicit no-match behavior is preferable to silently treating a low-scoring row as authority.
The inspected Python search implementation uses standard-library BM25, field-aware caching, stable file snapshots and confidence/coverage checks. These are useful bounded retrieval patterns.
Reasoning rules use a closed JSON contract with allowlisted conditions and action prefixes rather than executing arbitrary expressions.
Persistence uses safe names, explicit output directory and atomic creation; overwriting requires the force path.
MIT source; the skill can be portable when its Python helpers, CSV data and references travel together. The optional npm installer is a separate Node/client-write surface.
risks: Dataset rows prescribe fashionable styles by business category, including glass effects and broad accessibility labels. Retrieved preference is not user research, legal compliance or visual evidence.
The inspected initial reasoning CSV rows have empty reasoning/confidence cells; the output must not imply evidence that those fields do not contain.
Timing and style anti-pattern rules can conflict with actual task needs. Generating a full design system for a small component repair wastes context.
Claude plugin-root syntax and Codex target paths differ; copying only SKILL.md breaks runtime assumptions.
No upstream helper, installer or behavioral test was executed in this review.
application: Keep retrieval optional and query-bounded; make actual brief, existing tokens and platform authoritative.
Preserve abstention and source path/revision in future design reference search.
Use a detected stack and native-versus-web distinction for frontend/mobile roles.
Require companion-file and executable readiness checks before exposing a helper command; do not install the npm CLI as part of skill selection.

kind: Landing-page and component design skill with a theme/reference system
findings: Distinguishes component work from a full page, reads the existing implementation and treats structural variety as more than recoloring.
Useful composition axes include heading placement, content relationship, image treatment, grouping, rhythm and action placement.
State guidance exposes easily missed focus, pending, error and narrow-layout problems; final critique asks whether the work is specific to the brief.
MIT; much of the craft is portable Markdown, but the complete workflow assumes its theme/token files, logs and preflight artifacts.
risks: Mandatory questions and confirmation gates can repeat information already supplied and obstruct authorized execution.
Gate 54 explicitly overrides requests to preserve a reference layout. This conflicts with user and project authority.
Universal font/layout/color bans and forced difference from the previous output confuse a house style with quality and can damage coherent brand families.
Every-control eight-state requirements are overbroad. aria-disabled styling does not itself disable a control, and prescribed focus destinations need contextual judgment.
Its APCA and WCAG values are presented as approximate substitutes; conformance must be checked using the applicable standard.
Root token and theme references need a complete packaging/path review before installing the whole skill. Some long source sections were inspected selectively, not line-certified.
application: Author brief-derived composition guidance without compulsory visual novelty or a fixed aesthetic.
Use a relevant state/device matrix instead of requiring every state on every control.
Ask a fresh reviewer for located defects and user impact rather than trusting a maker's numeric taste score.
Keep full Hallmark as an explicit opt-in reference; do not make its file ceremony or style gates the global design lead.

kind: Opinionated frontend, redesign and raster mobile concept skill collection
findings: The main skill now explicitly scopes itself to landing pages and portfolios; it is not a general application UI authority.
Useful methods infer audience, reference, constraints and existing product language before styling, then establish one visual direction.
The mobile image-generation sibling explicitly produces raster concepts only; its output is not functional mobile implementation.
MIT Markdown collection; no need to run the shell indexing helper to select a reviewed payload.

At baseline, the installable redesign payload at old pin ce26fc25c0e5e8cab638f883de62d9a86ee5e45b inserted a truthful-content note but left contradictory fabricated-metric and randomized-date instructions. Integration subsequently added the two counted replacements and the recomputed registry hash; exact evidence is in design.md.
risks: The redesign sibling tells the agent to use organic-looking invented numbers and randomize publication dates. These are factual-integrity defects, not merely taste preferences.
Absolute font/palette/layout bans, image and motion quotas, mandatory generation and framework/library installation instructions exceed a portable design reference's authority.
Banning handcrafted SVG conflicts with genuine vector illustration, editable icons and diagram work.
The mobile concept sibling's premium/iPhone framing and high image eagerness may misfit Android, utilitarian or accessibility-first briefs.
skill.sh uses associative Bash arrays, so its interpreter assumptions need checking on macOS; selecting files directly avoids that dependency.
Long main/mobile skill bodies received deep relevant-section review, not every-line certification.
application: Retain the corrected taste-redesign-skill replacements/hash and verify materialized copies during integration; reject payloads if the expected replacement counts or source hash drift.
Keep the full main skill manual and subjective style variants explicit opt-ins.
Use the authored interface lead for actual task, truthful content, accessible states and render inspection.
Route raster mobile concepts to imagegen, working screens to interface/mobile engineering, and editable vector work to graphic-design.

kind: Architecture diagram skill, typed artifact contract and Node rendering/delivery runtime
findings: Strong semantic discipline: infer architecture from actual code paths, distinguish reads/writes from orchestration, and link source evidence to a credential-free origin and commit.
Diagram type follows the reader's question: architecture, workflow, sequence, lifecycle and dataflow have different contracts.
Typed source, render receipts and strict delivery checks make artifact freshness and provenance reviewable.
Layout repair preserves nodes, edges, directions and guards while improving placement and routing; simplifying cannot silently delete meaning.
MIT core, Node 18+ runtime and browser-related delivery path; individual embedded brand assets and fonts have separate notices.
risks: The current normal generation path makes perceptual inspection optional; machine checks cannot establish final-use readability.
Deliver/finalize paths include an update-check child process with network/cache behavior. The full distribution is an executable tool, not only Markdown guidance.
Projected text floors around 6-7.5 pixels are inappropriate as a universal final-use readability standard.
Third-party marks include attribution, share-alike and noncommercial licenses; MIT at the repository root is insufficient for asset reuse.
CLI and update contracts were inspected in relevant sections/search hits, not exhaustively executed or certified.
application: Adopt semantic fidelity and artifact-bound evidence into graphic/diagram workflows.
Require actual rendered inspection at destination size, including all focal labels and relationships.
Keep the runtime optional with explicit dependency/network readiness; do not install it as a side effect of role selection.
Prefer plain semantic shapes or reviewed licensed marks; preserve per-asset notices when assets are used.

kind: Interaction, animation, mobile and adversarial UI testing skills
findings: Break-ui uses plausible adversarial data at the schema/data boundary: missing fields, zero/one/many items, long text, large values, translations, RTL and narrow containers.
A development-only fixture selector and retained regression fixture make a visual defect reproducible without corrupting product markup.
Motion review considers purpose, frequency, transform origin, interruption and repeated input rather than adding animation indiscriminately.
Mobile guidance covers keyboard, safe-area and viewport behavior, readable inputs and touch/pointer differences.
Explicit-only prototype activation and meaningful variant axes are useful safeguards against unsolicited rewrites.
MIT; the reviewed skill/reference files are portable prose, with project-specific React/CSS/Expo examples requiring stack adaptation.
risks: Absolute timing, input-animation and property bans conflict with context-dependent examples elsewhere in the collection.
Claims that a particular transform/library always guarantees hardware acceleration or smoothness require runtime evidence.
Native guidance can assume no hover or prescribe a library without considering hybrid peripherals and the project's existing stack.
Break-ui's stop-and-ask step should not block repairs already authorized by the user.
A tooltip or title attribute alone is not a sufficient path to essential truncated content for every input mode.
application: Use data-driven adversarial fixtures as the QA Design failure probes.
Require motion reversal/repeated input/reduced-motion checks when motion changes.
Distinguish mobile browser, simulator/emulator and physical-device evidence.
Keep bounded specialist invocation rather than loading every animation/mobile skill for every screen.

kind: Diagram composition skill with packaged validation and repository render tooling
findings: Selects a semantic pattern before visual treatment and preserves states, guards, trust boundaries and relationships when importing source material.
Accessible SVG contracts, unique IDs and explicit titles/descriptions are useful output requirements.
The packaged Python self-check uses only standard-library parsing and checks unsafe elements/attributes, remote references and a constrained motion controller.
Repository rendering checks use source/image hashes and paint-sensitive overflow evidence rather than trusting a saved screenshot's existence.
MIT core; plugin manifests exist for both target hosts. Fonts and icon collections have separate notices and are not universal rights to use underlying brands.
risks: Default node/edge and short-label budgets can erase important meaning; split or restructure instead of silently truncating.
Mandatory style gates, font exclusions and no-shadow rules impose a house style, not universal diagram quality.
Google Fonts allowance means some nominally self-contained output still has a network/font dependency.
Repository-only renderer/linter scripts are not automatically present in an installed skill payload; distinguish packaged self-check from developer gates.
Source and screenshot hashes establish identity/freshness, not semantic or visual acceptance.
application: Use semantic fidelity, accessible labels and final-use inspection in the graphic-design lead.
Adopt artifact-bound capture provenance where a screenshot is part of delivery evidence.
Preserve companion resources for any installable subset and verify referenced paths.
Keep fixed style recipes optional and avoid bundling third-party marks without a specific need and rights review.

kind: Desktop/daemon design runtime, skill protocol and mixed-origin skill collection
findings: Distinguishes portable skill files, discovery metadata, prompt composition and runtime trust; skill capability declarations are not permission grants.
Stage policy requires an expected bundled origin/hash and a narrow key shape; third-party declarations cannot silently claim trusted orchestration semantics.
Brief/reference guidance separates provided, observed and inferred facts, establishes keep/change boundaries and packages sufficient context for downstream work.
Actual prompt paths include several runtimes and contract variants. A policy's presence in one composition branch does not prove application in all paths.
The selected design-review and canvas-design bodies are primarily promotion/activation wrappers; they are not complete review or illustration capabilities.
Apache-2.0 root, but mixed-origin skill licenses require per-payload review. The runtime requests Node ~24 and pnpm 10.33.x, has postinstall behavior and numerous workspace/native dependencies.
risks: Local plugin sources can receive broad trusted defaults; the harness should not infer trust simply from a filesystem origin.
The reference-design-contract's fixed document/headings prescription and current skill protocol disagree; copying both creates competing authority.
Universal five-state, timeout/retry and focus rules can mishandle actual contracts and non-idempotent actions.
Some named capabilities are thin wrappers or mirrored material, so catalog registration alone does not establish meaningful capability.
The 15,352-path tree was enumerated; only named relevant files were downloaded/read. No whole-runtime security or behavior certification is claimed.
application: Keep one authoritative execution contract and verify each target host's actual selection-to-invocation path.
Register source identity, companion files, explicit runtime readiness and effective permission boundary separately.
Reuse one task record for brief, assumptions, state cases and proof instead of requiring a new document set.
Do not promote the thin wrappers into lead roles; use authored interface and graphic-design leads.
Defer the full desktop/daemon product; it is not a prerequisite for useful craft guidance.

kind: Design skill and native engine with automatic lifecycle hooks
findings: Separates persuasion, operation, reading and experience surfaces, so review can judge a screen against its purpose.
Polish triages broken tasks, state/flow problems, system drift and local cosmetic defects rather than making every screen more decorative.
Capture fingerprints and artifact-bound review records help prevent stale evidence from being called current.
A focused review packet can include the brief, actual render, target viewport and diff before an independent reviewer sees the maker's verdict.
Apache-2.0 with third-party notices; package 4.5.2 requires Node >=22.18 and provides native engine 0.1.14 packages.
risks: The launcher can download a platform binary on first run, verify its sidecar checksum, chmod and execute it; it also searches environment, cache and PATH candidates.
The plugin hooks run on SessionStart, PostToolUse Edit/Write and Stop. Installing this is a persistent runtime integration, not merely reading design guidance.
Exact aesthetic floors and mandatory concept-generation/confirmation steps can conflict with an existing product, a complete brief or routine repair scope.
A brief-wins principle coexists with unconditional aesthetic bans; the harness must retain user/project authority.
Native UI has no HTML detector shortcut; device/emulator evidence is still necessary. No launcher, hook or engine was executed.
application: Adapt purpose-based triage, system-drift diagnosis and current-evidence review packets into authored skill guidance.
Keep full engine and hooks behind explicit setup/readiness review, with their network and client-write behavior visible.
Do not treat checksum verification as authorization to download or run a new binary.
Use meaningful alternative compositions only when needed; avoid compulsory novelty for every task.

kind: Video creation, markup and rendering skill collection
findings: Routes creation, composition markup, rendering and specialist topics separately rather than loading all video rules at once.
Deterministic frame/fps-derived timing is essential for reproducible video rendering; wall-clock CSS playback is not equivalent.
Transition overlaps affect total duration differently from overlays; loaded-font measurement and editable element boundaries improve dependable composition.
The source sync script embeds selected skills, so upstream and bundled copies can differ unless versions/hashes are checked.
No repository or skill license/notice file was found in the pinned tree, and package.json has no license field. Redistribution permission for these skill texts is unverified.
risks: Do not infer the skill repository license from the separate Remotion library license or its availability on GitHub.
Creation instructions can invoke latest-version scaffolding and dependency installs; these need explicit environment/dependency authorization.
A preview-only default can underdeliver a request for a finished video. Define final artifact versus editable project early.
Rendering needs the actual compatible Node/React/Remotion/browser/media toolchain; cloud rendering can add account and cost boundaries.
New API guidance must match the project's pinned version. No code, scaffold or renderer was executed.
application: Keep the source as a manual reference until redistribution permission is established.
Independently author timing, text, playback and encoded-artifact inspection guidance without copying the unlicensed skill text.
Route to an already available renderer only when the deliverable needs it, with explicit version/readiness evidence.
Inspect playback plus focal and transition frames; a successful render command alone does not establish visual quality.
